title: A homeomorphism preserves topological Krull dimension
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be topological spaces and $h:X\to Y$ a homeomorphism. Then their topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] agree: $\dim X=\dim Y$.

source.place: Topology, Definition Tag 0055 (definition-Krull), lines 1392-1418, clause (3): Krull dimension is the supremum of lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets; a homeomorphism identifies these chains
